messages.subject: geom_abline -  gradient does not work?
parts:
Dear Hadley et al.,

This works as expected:

mydata <- data.frame(x = 1:10, y = 1:10)
qplot(x, y, data = mydata) + geom_abline(intercept = 0, gradient = 1)

So does this:

qplot(x, y, data = mydata) + geom_abline(intercept = 5, gradient = 1)

But this does not:

qplot(x, y, data = mydata) + geom_abline(intercept = 0, gradient = 2)

...seems that it is not picking up on the value of intercept.

David
